q: India finished at which position in the medal tally of the 2026 Commonwealth Games held in Glasgow?
explanation: India finished 4th in the CWG 2026 medal tally with 39 medals, including 13 gold, marking a historic campaign led by strong showings in boxing and para athletics.

q: Which city will host the 2030 Commonwealth Games, following the handover from Glasgow 2026?
explanation: Ahmedabad has been confirmed as the host city for the 2030 Commonwealth Games, following the formal handover ceremony at the close of CWG 2026 in Glasgow.

q: PM Modi inaugurated the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport in August 2026. In which state is it located?
explanation: The airport, located at Bhogapuram in the Vizianagaram district of Andhra Pradesh, was inaugurated by PM Modi on 1 August 2026 and built at an estimated cost of ₹5,000 crore by the GMR Group.

q: Asmita Dey, who became the first Indian judoka to win a Commonwealth Games gold medal, represents which category and state?
explanation: Asmita Dey from Tripura won India's first-ever judo gold at the Commonwealth Games in the women's 48 kg category, defeating Canada's Heidi Quach in Glasgow 2026.

q: Renowned mountaineer Nirmal Purja (Nimsdai), known for his 'Project Possible' expedition, was killed in an avalanche in which mountain range in early August 2026?
explanation: Nirmal Purja, famous for summiting all 14 eight-thousanders in just over 6 months, was killed in an avalanche in the Karakoram range in Pakistan.

q: The 28th meeting of SBSTTA (Subsidiary Body on Scientific, Technical and Technological Advice) concluded on 1 August 2026 in which city?
explanation: SBSTTA-28, a scientific advisory body under the Convention on Biological Diversity, concluded its meeting in Nairobi, Kenya on 1 August 2026.

q: Parliament passed the Public Examinations (Prevention of Unfair Means) Amendment Bill, 2026 primarily in response to which incident?
explanation: The Amendment Bill was passed after widespread protests over the NEET-UG 2026 paper leak, aiming to strengthen deterrence against organized exam-fraud syndicates after gaps were found in the original 2024 Act.

q: The PM-KISAN scheme was recently extended by the Union Cabinet for five more years, up to which financial year, with what total outlay?
explanation: The Union Cabinet extended PM-KISAN till 2030-31 with a total outlay of ₹3,15,614 crore, continuing ₹6,000/year direct financial assistance to eligible farmer families.

q: The Favara-UPI cross-border payment corridor, which recently went live, connects India's UPI with the payment system of which country?
explanation: Customers of Bank of Maldives and Maldives Islamic Bank can now make person-to-person transfers directly to UPI-enabled Indian bank accounts, expanding UPI's international footprint.

q: PM Modi launched a nationwide campaign in 2026 aimed at building a drug-free youth population, called:
options: Nasha Mukt Yuva for Viksit Bharat Sankalp Abhiyan
explanation: The campaign calls for a drug-free youth population as essential to building a developed India by 2047, given the rising vulnerability of India's youth to substance abuse.
